scripts.test: grep -q 'aria-live="polite"' index.html && grep -q 'aria-describedby="char-count"' index.html && grep -q 'aria-label' index.html && echo 'Accessibility checks passed.'
scripts.lint: grep -q 'lang="en"' index.html && grep -q '<meta charset="UTF-8">' index.html && echo 'Basic linting passed.'
